name: Bellwater Priory crypt door
notes: The crypt door at the foot of the crypt stair (mw-e26.5 AC-2): sealed from the priory side (bible 4.1 beat 9) whatever the player does. No key exists and the tier is 3 so no early pick opens it; the edge crypt-stair-crypt opens only when world.priory-crypt.unsealed is set, from the Knot side (mw-e26.20 replaces this lock with that fact).
hint: Sealed. Cold air breathes through the crack, from the other side.
